result.question: What did the old prophet instruct his sons to do, and what did he do next?

readings.answer: He told them to saddle the donkey for him; next, he went and found the body lying in the road.
readings.support: Saddle the donkey for me. | he went and found the body lying in the road

readings.answer: He told them to saddle the donkey for him; next, he lifted up the body, laid it on the donkey, and brought it back to his city.
readings.support: Saddle the donkey for me. | So the old prophet lifted up the body of the man of God, laid it on the donkey, and brought it back to his own city

assessments.reason: Matches the sequence in the passage: “Saddle the donkey for me” (v27) and then “he went and found the body lying in the road” (v28).

It treats the ‘next’ action as lifting and transporting the body, but verse 28 states the immediate next action was “he went and found the body,” while lifting and bringing it back occurs later in verse 29.

result.reason: The passage explicitly states he told them to saddle the donkey and then went and found the body lying in the road.
